author: Scott McNeill
text:
This company will use an excavator to dig and tear up your lawn. Plus, this guy had an attitude the whole time, and though it was necessary to drive the excavator all over my new grass. I DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!
Edit Update as 12-3
As people can see from the response, this guy has nothing but excuses and will not take responsibility. In the picture, you can see this guy drove the excavator to the far right side of the yard for no reason when the septic area is towards the far left. You can see 2x 24 by 24 inch square blocks that I placed down where the septic lids are located. I told the guy that is where he needs to dig, and he will find the lid, but he did not want to listen. I told him that 1 hole is about 12 inches down, and the other is about 15 inches down, and there is no reason to use an excavator, but he did not want to listen. There are plenty of other companies out there, and this is one I Do Not Recommend.

author: Philip Wilson
text: I needed a septic tank replaced and they were very quick to respond right after my first call to them. Assisted with the application/permit process and made it so easy to be completed. Came right out to look at what was needed and very easy to talk to about what was needed to complete the job. Even went out of their way to help with additional work that was found to be needed. I will most definitely use them again!!

author: Tom
text: This was a great experience.  He was super easy to schedule and communication was great on the day of our appointment. The job was executed with professionalism and respect for our property.   I highly recommend them.

author: Rob Shelsky
text: I just had my septic tank cleaned out, and they did a marvelous job. Even went above and beyond what was required of them. And when the work was done they smoothed everything out and it looks perfect. I recommend them wholeheartedly, and trust me, I mean it! They do good work. They complete the job and don't leave a mess. Better than that, they made it look better than it was before it started! Again, I would recommend them without reservation! And if I ever need work done on my septic again, Derrick Septic is the one I will use. I trust them and their work. These days, it's hard to find people who really want to do the work and do it right. Thank god, there are still people like Derrick Septic who care enough to do that! Oh, and one other thing; their prices are very reasonable and affordable.

author: NRG 1
text: While I am sympathetic to issues that arise when it happens they rescheduled the appointment 2 times when we were closing on a home and had a time constraint. When they actually did the inspection they did not check the water flow from the house to the septic system that would have uncovered an issue that had i not partially fixed myself would have cost me 9k to fix. The last septic inspection included that. They didn't do that.
